# Academic Integrity – University of Toronto

> U of T's comprehensive resource for understanding and maintaining academic integrity through the Code of Behaviour on Academic Matters, with guidance on misconduct prevention, disciplinary procedures, and support resources.

This site serves University of Toronto students, instructors, and staff with policies, procedures, and educational resources for academic integrity. It covers the full spectrum from prevention strategies and common misconduct risks to formal disciplinary processes and appeals through the University Tribunal.

## Key Topics

- Code of Behaviour on Academic Matters
- Plagiarism
- Academic Misconduct
- University Tribunal
- Disciplinary Process
- Exam Integrity
- Student Conduct
- Plagiarism Prevention
- Academic Offences
- Course Design
- Citations and Paraphrasing
- Instructor Strategies
- Consequences and Sanctions
- Verification of Illness Forms
- Group Work Policies

## Core Policies & Overview

- [Academic Integrity – University of Toronto](https://www.academicintegrity.utoronto.ca): Homepage defining U of T's Code of Behaviour on Academic Matters and core integrity policies.
- [Key Contacts – Academic Integrity](https://www.academicintegrity.utoronto.ca/key-contacts): Directory of U of T contacts for reporting violations and disciplinary process support.

## Misconduct Risks & Examples

- [Risky situations – Academic Integrity](https://www.academicintegrity.utoronto.ca/perils-and-pitfalls): Guide to misconduct risks including plagiarism, cheating, and AI ethics concerns.
- [Submitting someone else's work as your own – Academic Integrity](https://www.academicintegrity.utoronto.ca/submitting-someone-elses-work-as-your-own): Guide to plagiarism violations and consequences of submitting others' work.
- [Submitting a purchased assignment – Academic Integrity](https://www.academicintegrity.utoronto.ca/perils-and-pitfalls/submitting-a-purchased-essay): Explanation of misconduct involving purchased assignments and consequences.
- [Submitting shared work – Academic Integrity](https://www.academicintegrity.utoronto.ca/perils-and-pitfalls/submitting-shared-work): Explanation of group work policies and shared work submission violations.
- [Unreferenced quotes and passages – Academic Integrity](https://www.academicintegrity.utoronto.ca/perils-and-pitfalls/unreferenced-quotes-and-passages): Guide to proper citation of quotes and plagiarism prevention for graduate students.
- [Submitting a friend's old assignment – Academic Integrity](https://www.academicintegrity.utoronto.ca/perils-and-pitfalls/submitting-a-friends-old-assignment): Explanation of plagiarism violations involving resubmitted old assignments.
- [Altering test answers – Academic Integrity](https://www.academicintegrity.utoronto.ca/perils-and-pitfalls/altering-test-answers): Guide to exam fraud violations involving altered test answers.
- [Using a purchased, fake or forged medical (VOI) form – Academic Integrity](https://www.academicintegrity.utoronto.ca/perils-and-pitfalls/forgery-of-a-medical-certificate): Explanation of forged document violations involving verification of illness forms.

## Prevention Strategies

- [Smart Strategies – Academic Integrity](https://www.academicintegrity.utoronto.ca/smart-strategies): Student and instructor strategies for plagiarism prevention and exam integrity.
- [Citations, quoting and paraphrasing – Academic Integrity](https://www.academicintegrity.utoronto.ca/smart-strategies/citations-quoting-and-paraphrasing): Guide to proper citation styles and paraphrasing techniques for plagiarism prevention.
- [Course and assignment design – Academic Integrity](https://www.academicintegrity.utoronto.ca/smart-strategies/course-and-assignment-design): Instructor strategies for plagiarism prevention through course and assignment design.
- [Adding your own voice to a research assignment – Academic Integrity](https://www.academicintegrity.utoronto.ca/smart-strategies/adding-your-own-voice-to-a-research-assignment): Student guide to critical thinking and voice in research writing.
- [Cell phones in a test or exam – Academic Integrity](https://www.academicintegrity.utoronto.ca/smart-strategies/cell-phones-and-mobile-devices): Exam conduct guidelines regarding unauthorized mobile device use.
- [Working with your teaching assistant (TA) – Academic Integrity](https://www.academicintegrity.utoronto.ca/smart-strategies/working-with-your-teaching-assistant-ta): Guidance on TA responsibilities in plagiarism detection and academic misconduct.

## Consequences & Disciplinary Procedures

- [Key Consequences – Academic Integrity](https://www.academicintegrity.utoronto.ca/key-consequences): Overview of sanctions and disciplinary procedures for academic offences.
- [Process and Procedures – Academic Integrity](https://www.academicintegrity.utoronto.ca/process-and-procedures): Detailed disciplinary procedures from instructor reporting through tribunal.
- [University Tribunal – Academic Integrity](https://www.academicintegrity.utoronto.ca/key-consequences/university-tribunal): Details on University Tribunal hearing procedures and legal representation.

## Accessibility & Support

- [Accessibility Statement – Academic Integrity](https://www.academicintegrity.utoronto.ca/accessibility-statement): AODA compliance statement for accessibility accommodations and inclusive environment.
